name: linkedin-tracker
description: Standalone, per-BDR LinkedIn connection-request + cold-call lead tracker. Fully self-contained: ships its own read-only LinkedIn MCP and permission deny-list, keeps its own Notion tracking page and databases, and does not depend on the Conversation Hub / convohub-sync plugins. One install works for any BDR against their own LinkedIn login and Notion identity.

plugins.name: linkedin-tracker
plugins.description: /linkedin-tracker — reconciles the BDR's LinkedIn inbox (accepted/replied) against their own Notion tracking page, @-mentions them to send a same-day first message on new connections, and on send runs builds a lead list from their downloaded Salesforce reports and sends connection requests via Claude in Chrome (never via the MCP). Reads via a bundled read-only LinkedIn MCP; the connect action and all search actions are blocked by a bundled deny-list.
